The Beer Hall Putsch , also known as the Munich Putsch , [ 1 ] [ note 1 ] was a failed coup d'état led by Nazi Party leader Adolf Hitler , General Erich Ludendorff , and other Kampfbund leaders in Munich , Bavaria , on 8–9 November 1923 , during the Weimar Republic . Inspired by Benito Mussolini 's March on Rome , Hitler's goal was to use Munich as a base for a march against Germany's national government in Berlin .
